The home directory `/var/lib/webdav` is an appropriate location for service-specific data. No commands are executed, no network activity is initiated, and there is no code or logic that could be exploited for malicious purposes. The use of a dedicated system user is a common and recommended practice for services to limit potential damage in case of compromise.
